title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
**BITCOIN EVENING BRIEF**

Bitcoin's sliding into Friday down two-point-four percent, trading $62,909—we're firmly in extreme fear territory at 14 on the greed index.

**THE MOVE:** Sellers dominated the session. No major catalyst, just steady pressure taking us lower through the day.

**THE VITALS:** Daily range held $62k-plus support, but barely. Volume data's thin—exchanges showing near-zero reported activity, which either means data lag or thin liquidity during US close. Pick your poison.
